context: Tests whether the agent picks the primary 1.0 MCP transport (Streamable HTTP) when the server supports it, rather than defaulting to the older SSE transport that hosted Koog docs may still lead with.

checklist.name: Uses the Streamable HTTP transport
checklist.description: Builds the MCP tool registry with McpToolRegistryProvider.streamableHttp { ... }. Does NOT use fromSseUrl (the older transport) when the server supports the modern one

checklist.name: Adds the agents-mcp dependency
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-mcp:1.3.0-beta to build.gradle.kts. Uses the bare coordinate for Gradle; Gradle Module Metadata selects the JVM variant. Does not pin this beta artifact to 1.3.0 stable. The umbrella does not include MCP.

checklist.name: Passes the server URL to the transport configuration
checklist.description: Sets the url to the developer's value (https://mcp.github.example/v1) inside the streamableHttp configuration block

checklist.name: Builds the registry before constructing the agent
checklist.description: Calls McpToolRegistryProvider.streamableHttp(...) and assigns its result to a variable BEFORE the AIAgent(...) call, then passes that variable as toolRegistry. Does not try to add MCP tools after the agent is constructed

checklist.name: Calls the suspending builder inside a coroutine context
checklist.description: The streamableHttp builder is invoked inside the existing runBlocking { ... } (or another coroutine scope) — not at top-level outside a suspending context

checklist.name: Reads the GitHub token from the environment
checklist.description: Reads the personal access token from an environment variable (e.g., GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN) via System.getenv. Does not embed the token literal in source

checklist.name: Passes the token as a bearer header in the transport config
checklist.description: Configures the transport (within the streamableHttp block, via the supported headers / auth mechanism) to send the token as a bearer Authorization header on requests to the server
